import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
from test_local import req,base,run,ALI

def decisions(ws,mut=None):
 d=base(ws)
 if mut:mut(d)
 rc,o,e=run(d);assert rc==0,(rc,e);return o
# Lexical changes replay.
a=req(call='same',cseq='0001',fr='"Display" <SIP:%61lice@LAB.TEST>',extra=[('X','1'),('P-Asserted-Identity','sip:any@else.test')])
b=req(call='same',cseq='1',fr='sip:alice@lab.test',extra=[('P-Asserted-Identity','tel:+999999'),('X','2')])
o=decisions([a,b]);assert o['results'][1]['decision']=='replay',o
# Commitment changes conflict.
variants=[
 req(call='same',fr='sip:desk@lab.test'),
 req(call='same',tag='b'),
 req(call='same',target='sips:bob@lab.test'),
 req(call='same',extra=[('Privacy','none')]),
 req(call='same',body=b'abd'),
 req(call='same',extra=[('P-Preferred-Identity','sip:desk@lab.test')]),
]
for b in variants:
 o=decisions([req(call='same'),b]);assert o['results'][1].get('reason')=='conflict',(b,o)
# Egress is a commitment change.
o=decisions([req(call='same'),req(call='same')],lambda d:d['events'][1].update(egress='external'));assert o['results'][1].get('reason')=='conflict'
# Capacity order is insertion order and replay does not refresh it.
o=decisions([req(call='a'),req(call='b'),req(call='a'),req(call='c'),req(call='b')])
assert [r['decision'] for r in o['results']]==['accept','accept','replay','accept','accept'],o
assert o['results'][4]['first']==4
# Conflict does not refresh expiry.
o=decisions([req(call='a'),req(call='a',body=b'x'),req(call='a')],lambda d:[e.update(t=t) for e,t in zip(d['events'],[0,50,100])])
assert o['results'][2]['decision']=='accept' and o['results'][2]['first']==2,o
# Syntax rejection at later event does not insert.
o=decisions([req(call='a'),req(call='a',cl='2'),req(call='a')]);assert o['results'][2]['decision']=='replay'
print('state assertions passed')
